_about: Cross-region connection records (List 14 #127) — the connected-world discovery model as GAME DATA, in the route-graph layer beside region1-route-graph.json. A connection is a record with the closed discovery-kind vocabulary (progression | exploration | side-story | map-connection); discovery is derived per Ranger (open iff at least one kind's condition holds; once found, never un-found). ZERO connections are instanced: no region pair has verified node sets on both sides yet (Regions 2-5 have no verified node-level data) — nothing here is inferred. Kinds are per-connection content, authored by the region build, never pre-assigned.

arrivalStaging.firstArrivalFact: a story.* beat in the destination region's namespace, written on this Ranger's first crossing by ANY connection; fires exactly once, however early/late, by whichever door

connectionShape.discovery: derived per Ranger per connection: open iff at least one discoveryKind's condition holds; once true, never un-found

continuity.bands: destination region's own authored bands (#52: never read party state, never scaled to the visitor); early arrival meets the authored gradient as-is
continuity.dex: one global bitset store (#96); a regional dex is a derived view (#14 popcounts over the region's subset), never a second store; early discovery simply starts filling it early
continuity.licence: one licence (#98 view); each entered region's circuit renders as its own Fragment case view
continuity.research: #97 facts persist; levels re-derive per view
continuity.reset: NONE — no crossing resets, scales, confiscates, or transforms anything, ever
continuity.roster: unchanged by any crossing (#80 records, #104 honours, #68 locks, #106 location semantics all intact)

views.atlas: #137 world-atlas record (arrival-side facts) — the SAME edge, two views; this file is the one edge store, never two
